meta.title: Onboarding | Invessiv
meta.description: Give us everything we need for your project – at your own pace, step by step.

page.heading: Onboarding for {project}
page.ownerHint: In the portal view you can only read the onboarding.
page.readOnlyHint: You can read the onboarding, but not fill it in. Ask the person who looks after the project on your side.

overview.heading: Onboarding
overview.intro: This is where we collect everything we need for your project. You don’t have to finish in one go: every answer is saved right away.

empty.title: No onboarding for you yet
empty.description: As soon as we start a project with you, you’ll find its questionnaire here: texts, images, contacts and everything else in one place.

block.fallback: This section is only available in {language}.
block.prefilled: Taken over from your last onboarding. Please check that everything is still right.
block.locked: You can’t change this section right now.
block.empty: There is nothing to fill in here.

errors.too_long: This text is too long. Please shorten it a little.
errors.invalid_email: This doesn’t look like an email address.
errors.invalid_phone: This doesn’t look like a phone number.
errors.invalid_url: The link has to start with http:// or https://.
errors.invalid_color: Please enter the colour as a hex value, for example #1A2B3C.
errors.not_a_value_field: This field can’t be filled in here.

draft.leaveWarning: Your latest answers are not saved yet. Do you really want to leave the page?

submit.heading: Review & submit
submit.intro: Take one more look. Once you submit, we get all your answers and start working.
submit.complete: All required answers are in. You can submit.
submit.missingHeading: These required answers are still missing
submit.invalid: At least one field holds an answer we can’t save like this. Please correct it before you submit.
submit.notSaved: We couldn’t save everything. Try again before you submit.
submit.lockNotice: After submitting you can’t change your answers anymore. If something is still missing later, we’ll get in touch.

submitDialog.title: Submit the onboarding?
submitDialog.description: We get all your answers at once. After that you can’t change anything.

submitted.title: Submitted on {date}
submitted.description: Thank you. We’ll review your answers and get back to you.

changes_requested.title: We still have questions
changes_requested.description: Have a look at our questions. We’ll let you know as soon as you can answer them.

completed.title: Onboarding completed
completed.description: Everything is in. Your answers stay here for reference.

errors.not_found: This onboarding no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.locked: The onboarding just changed. You now see the current state.
errors.validation: We can’t save this answer like this. Please check it again.
errors.required_missing: Required answers are still missing. You now see which ones.
errors.not_attachable: This file can’t be attached here.
errors.unavailable: That didn’t work just now. Try again in a moment.
